summary: The Hateful Eight is a 2015 American western thriller written and directed by Quentin Tarantino. The film follows eight strangers who take shelter from a blizzard at a stagecoach stopover shortly after the American Civil War. The note names its ensemble cast and marketing alternate title, The H8ful Eight.
one_line: A 2015 Quentin Tarantino western thriller about eight strangers sheltering from a blizzard at a stagecoach stopover after the Civil War.
key_facts: The Hateful Eight is a 2015 American western thriller film.
The Hateful Eight is written and directed by Quentin Tarantino.
The film is often marketed as The H8ful Eight.
The film stars Samuel L. Jackson, Kurt Russell, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Walton Goggins, Demián Bichir, Tim Roth, Michael Madsen, and Bruce Dern.
The film's eight main characters are strangers who seek refuge from a blizzard.
The story takes place at a stagecoach stopover.
The story is set some time after the American Civil War.
